headline: Studio Fuksas-designed Rike Concert Hall in Tbilisi set to be demolished
context: The unopened Rike Concert Hall in Tbilisi, designed by Italian practice Studio Fuksas, is set to be demolished less than 15 years after it was completed. Tbilisi's city hall architecture department has issued a permit allowing the owner of the concert hall to demolish the buildin

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: The unopened Rike Concert Hall in Tbilisi, designed by Italian practice Studio Fuksas, is set to be demolished less than 15 years after it was completed. Tbilisi's city hall architecture department has issued a permit allowing the owner of the concert hall to demolish the building.
